# Deploy Checklist

A checklist for deploying the new version.

## Pre-deploy

- [x] Set up CI pipeline
- [/] Write migration scripts
- [ ] Run load tests
- [!] Fix auth vulnerability
- [-] Old deploy method (deprecated)

## Post-deploy

- [ ] Monitor error rates
- [ ] Update documentation
- [/] Notify stakeholders
- [x] Tag release in git
